title: Existence and uniqueness of the even symplectic skew-orthogonal polynomial Riemann–Hilbert problem for a real even-degree positive-leading-coefficient potential
author: Alex Little
work: A Riemann–Hilbert Approach to Skew-Orthogonal Polynomials of Symplectic Type
source_version: Official SIGMA 20 (2024) article 076, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2024.076; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-09-30, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The author constructs the matrix solution by linking vanishing integrals on multiple steepest-decay rays to a polynomial differential image. A uniform entire-function argument, an explicit contour construction and nondegeneracy of the skew moment form establish the independent moment functionals needed to solve all rows. The Riemann–Hilbert normalization and skew-orthogonal characterization follow from these substantive constructions.
